work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letters CCLVII (ad futuram rei memoriam) condemn the slave trade in Africans and Indians, recalling Paul III, Urban VIII, Benedict XIV, Pius II and Pius VII, and forbid anyone to defend it as lawful; LF56822 → LF56828 across page number 387 LF56825; LF56884 → LF56889–56902 (retained notes) → LF56908 across own provenance LF56887 and page number 388 LF56905; complete 3 December 1839 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF56774–56774; the source closing at LF56965–56968 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die tertia decembris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo nono, pon- tificatus Nostri anno nono. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
